title: Update on Pilot for Pre-implantation Genetic Screening and its Inclusion as Mainstream Clinical Service
what_it_is: Update on Pilot for Pre-implantation Genetic Screening and its Inclusion as Mainstream Clinical Service

sections.label: PGS pilot enrolment and outcomes
sections.summary: As of January 2024, 590 patients were enrolled, 195 underwent PGS, leading to 70 pregnancies, 56 live births and five ongoing pregnancies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As of January 2024, 590 patients were enrolled to the study but only 195 patients had undergone PGS.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This has led to 70 pregnancies with 56 live births and five ongoing pregnancies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: More patients need to be recruited into the pilot for a robust evaluation of the clinical efficacy of PGS, before it can be determined if PGS can be a mainstream clinical service.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In the meantime, PGS will remain accessible to eligible patients.

sections.label: PGS access and referrals
sections.summary: Not all follow through, so the number for statistical reference is not achieved, but PGS remains accessible and referrals can be made.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The problem is not all then follow through with the process, for many different reasons.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And because of that, we have not yet achieved that number for a good statistical reference.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The fact remains that right now the PGS remains accessible to people and experts in the private centres can make referrals to the three AR centres and in the public setting.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Just because early detection may be valuable for certain circumstances, this does not mean we should deploy all of them and we should subsidise all of them.

sections.label: Side effects to blastocyst
sections.summary: In this case, there are some side effects that may happen to the blastocyst.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In this particular case, as we understand, there are some side effects that may happen to the blastocyst.
